overall: The AG found the Fall River City Council violated the Open Meeting Law by approving minutes several months late, declined to find an intentional violation, and ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Council failed to approve meeting minutes in a timely manner, citing April 25, 2017 Council and June 5, 2017 Real Estate Committee minutes approved months later.
allegations.key_passage: Regardless of which timeliness standard we apply, it is clear that the Council delayed several months before approving the minutes at issue.

allegations.summary: Complainant urged that the minutes delay was an intentional violation of the Open Meeting Law; the AG considered whether prior notice made it knowing.
allegations.key_passage: Because a quorum of the members who violated the law in the present instance are not the same members who violated the law before, we decline to find an intentional violation.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Council's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law

source.publisher_filename: DETERMINATION - 5 8 2018 - OML 2018-64 - FALL RIVER CITY COUNCIL.pdf
